retrievalProfile.description: A dense, multi-layered surrealist collage merging deep space elements like lightning and planets with lush tropical jungle flora and human figures.
excludeWhen: realistic nature photography without cosmic elements

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, saturated composition featuring a central group of figures emerging from a dense tropical undergrowth, set against a black starfield background dominated by a massive glowing white orb, a lightning strike, and a distant planet.
coreVisualRelationships: Juxtaposition of organic jungle life against cold cosmic space
Centralized human figures framed by foreground foliage and background celestial light
High-contrast lighting with a dominant white glow behind the subjects
Vibrant primary colors in the foreground contrasting with the deep black and blue of the background
coreInvariants: Deep black starfield with four-pointed star glints
Lush, saturated green jungle foliage in the lower third
A massive, soft-edged white circular glow as the primary light source
A single, detailed lightning bolt at the top center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five figures occupies the center-middle ground, scaled to appear as if emerging from the brush.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white glowing orb in the center background acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central glow, moves upward to the lightning, then downward through the figures into the detailed jungle foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and top edges are reserved for the black starfield, providing breathing room for the dense center.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red, Green, and Yellow (jungle flora)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme high value in the center (white) fading into deep low value (black), with high saturation in the foreground elements.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain deep, pure blacks in the space regions

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair a bold, extended sans-serif for the primary name with a lighter, italicized version of the same family for the secondary title.
graphicDevices: Contrast between bold and italic weights

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical 90s aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary geometric and wide footprint.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal collage: the bottom half is a dense, vibrant tropical jungle with red mushrooms and exotic flowers; the top half is a black starfield with a large central white glowing orb, a lightning bolt at the top, and a small Earth-like planet on the right. Place a group of figures in the middle ground emerging from the leaves.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two words in the upper-middle section using a white, extra-extended geometric sans-serif font. The first word should be bold and the second word should be italicized.

verificationChecks: Is the central white orb the brightest element?
Is the typography extended and geometric?
Are the jungle colors highly saturated against the black space?
Is there a lightning bolt centered at the top?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the central white glow
Number of figures in the center
Presence of specific flora like mushrooms or orchids
mustRedesign: Exact placement of stars and lightning branches

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of space and jungle elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lightning bolt is visible and sharp.
Check that the typography is perfectly horizontal and centered.
Verify the transition between the jungle and the starfield is distinct yet integrated.
Confirm the Earth-like planet is positioned in the upper right quadrant.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Environment A: Deep Space] with [Environment B: Tropical Jungle] using [Visual Bridge: Glowing White Orb] and top with [Graphic Element: Lightning Bolt] and [Type Style: Extended Geometric Sans].
